title: MARBLE: An Agentic Benchmark for Spatial Reasoning and Visual Abstraction
abstract: arXiv:2506.22992v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A central challenge for multimodal language models (MLLMs) in real-world tasks is to abstract visual observations into structured spatial states and reason over how those states change under actions over long horizons. Existing multimodal benchmarks often focus on static question answering, where answers can be directly extracted from images, or assume symbolic states are available and bypass the visual-to-spatial abstraction process. We present MARBLE, a diagnostic benchmark for spatially grounded multimodal reasoning and planning across three agent environments: CUBE, MAZE, and BLOX. MARBLE spans 2D and 3D spatial puzzles under geometric constraints, dynamic layouts, and spatial transformations, with difficulty systematically controlled along two axes: observation format and planning horizon. Extensive evaluations show that frontier MLLMs struggle on MARBLE, with the strongest model GPT-5.4 achieving only a 7.3% average success rat

translated_title: MARBLE：一个用于空间推理与视觉抽象的智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 多模态语言模型（MLLMs）在真实世界任务中的一个核心挑战是将视觉观察抽象为结构化的空间状态，并对这些状态在长时间序列动作下的变化进行推理。现有的多模态基准测试往往聚焦于静态问答（其答案可直接从图像中提取），或者假设符号状态已经可用而跳过从视觉到空间的抽象过程。我们提出了MARBLE，这是一个针对空间接地多模态推理与规划的诊断性基准测试，涵盖三个智能体环境：CUBE、MAZE和BLOX。MARBLE包含几何约束、动态布局和空间变换下的2D和3D空间谜题，并通过两个维度（观察格式和规划时域）系统地控制难度。广泛的评估表明，前沿MLLMs在MARBLE上表现不佳，其中最强的模型GPT-5.4仅取得了7.3%的平均成功率。
tldr: 提出了MARBLE基准测试，通过三个智能体环境系统评估多模态语言模型的空间推理与视觉抽象能力，发现最强模型GPT-5.4的平均成功率仅为7.3%，揭示了现有模型在此类任务上的巨大局限。
en_tdlr: MARBLE, a diagnostic benchmark for spatially grounded multimodal reasoning and planning across three agent environments, reveals that frontier MLLMs struggle with spatial reasoning, with the strongest model GPT-5.4 achieving only a 7.3% average success rate.
